name: Adaptive Streamline Generation
definition: An iterative algorithm to generate streamlines by starting with a fixed number of seeds, extending them via CUDA kernels, and recursively adding new seeds based on the endpoints of previously generated lines until a maximum number of adaptive steps is reached or no new lines are generated.
summary: Adaptive Streamline Generation is an iterative CUDA algorithm that dynamically refines streamlines in turbulent regions while maintaining sparsity in laminar areas, differing from static seeding by recursively extending lines based on flow divergence.
